title: It’s Not the Oscars: U.N. Speakers Love to Ignore Its 15-Minute Rule
summary_full: The chronic flouting of the time limit for speeches highlights a fundamental feature of the United Nations: It is made up of sovereign states that it cannot force to do anything.
